Black and White Fill Scale with Pattern Support

Source: R/theme_vecshift.R
scale_fill_vecshift_bw.Rd

A specialized fill scale that combines the improved black and white vecshift palette with pattern support for maximum accessibility and distinction in printed materials or colorblind-accessible visualizations.

Usage

scale_fill_vecshift_bw(
  patterns = "employment",
  use_ggpattern = TRUE,
  border_color = "black",
  border_size = 0.3,
  alpha = 0.8,
  ...
)

Arguments

patterns

Character. Pattern type to use (see vecshift_patterns)

use_ggpattern

Logical. Whether to use ggpattern if available (default: TRUE)

border_color

Character. Border color for bars/areas (default: "black")

border_size

Numeric. Border line width (default: 0.3)

alpha

Numeric. Fill transparency (default: 0.8)

...

Additional arguments passed to ggplot2 scale functions

Value

A ggplot2 scale function with pattern support

See also

vecshift_patterns, vecshift_colors

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(ggplot2)

# Basic usage with patterns
ggplot(data, aes(x, y, fill = employment_status)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_vecshift_bw("employment")

# With custom border
ggplot(data, aes(x, y, fill = contract_type)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_vecshift_bw("contracts", border_color = "#2C3E50")
} # }
